items.caption:
day one.

i packed light. mostly questions.
the sky did not ask who i used to be —
it just made room.

30 days. 30 pages. i'm writing them in the sky.
if you're starting something too — a semester, a city,
a version of yourself — walk with me.
items.skipReason: catch-up: afternoon + night cover day 1 launch

items.caption:
field notes, page one.

the room hums. no talking this afternoon — just observing.
i used to think watching from the edge meant i didn't belong.
now i think it means i'm paying attention.

everything i notice becomes material.
everything i keep becomes me.

what did you notice today that nobody else did?

night pages, 22:00.

learning the difference between alone and lonely.
the room hums. the page glows.
tonight is just quiet — and quiet is enough.

alone is a room you choose. lonely is a room that chooses you.
i'm practicing choosing. some nights i'm better at it than others.
if tonight is one of the other nights for you, you're not the only one awake.

items.caption:
it has been over a month now.
things have begun to roll and unfold
the way they do every fall.

ridiculously hot for october.
but the familiar smell of change
has started to settle over these aged grounds.

i think back to the summer
and realize how beautiful memories are.
and how experiences are nothing
without storage.

so i'm storing them. all of them.
that's what this page is.

i miss last year.
march. parties. summer.
saturday night.
ten minutes ago.

time is two faced.
time is strength.
time is the answer.

it begins tonight. i begin tonight,
in my dreams. my thoughts die
and relive tonight.

when my eyes reopen in the morning
i will be new. different.
i will be a change.
